concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Fractions as parts of a whole
concepts.description: A fraction a/b names a parts out of b equal parts of a whole.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Equivalent fractions
concepts.description: Multiplying or dividing numerator and denominator by the same number gives an equal fraction; adding the same amount does not.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Comparing fractions
concepts.description: Compare fractions using common denominators or numerators; a bigger denominator means smaller pieces.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Common denominators
concepts.description: Rewrite fractions with the same denominator using equivalent fractions.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Adding and subtracting fractions
concepts.description: Add or subtract numerators only after the denominators match; the denominator stays the same.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Multiplying fractions
concepts.description: Multiply numerators together and denominators together.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Ratios
concepts.description: A ratio compares two quantities multiplicatively; equivalent ratios scale both terms by the same factor.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Unit rates
concepts.description: A unit rate says how much of one quantity per 1 of the other.

concepts.subject: math
concepts.name: Proportional reasoning
concepts.description: Solve for a missing value by scaling with a constant multiplier or unit rate.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Position and displacement
concepts.description: Position locates an object; displacement is the change in position, with direction.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Speed and velocity
concepts.description: Velocity is the rate of change of position, with direction.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Acceleration
concepts.description: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity; it can be nonzero even when velocity is momentarily zero.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Force
concepts.description: A force is a push or pull; it is a vector with size and direction.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Gravity and weight
concepts.description: Gravity pulls on mass; weight is that force. All objects accelerate equally under gravity without air resistance.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Free fall
concepts.description: Objects under gravity alone have constant downward acceleration of about 9.8 m/s^2, whatever their velocity.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Newton's first law
concepts.description: With zero net force an object keeps its velocity; motion does not need a force.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Newton's second law
concepts.description: Net force = mass x acceleration.

concepts.subject: physics
concepts.name: Newton's third law
concepts.description: Forces come in equal and opposite pairs acting on different objects.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Atomic structure
concepts.description: Atoms have a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Atomic number and mass number
concepts.description: Atomic number = protons; mass number = protons + neutrons.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Isotopes and ions
concepts.description: Isotopes differ in neutrons; ions differ in electrons from protons, giving charge.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: The periodic table
concepts.description: Elements are ordered by atomic number; groups share valence electrons.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Ionic and covalent bonding
concepts.description: Ionic bonds transfer electrons; covalent bonds share them.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Chemical formulas
concepts.description: Subscripts count atoms of each element in a compound.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: The mole
concepts.description: One mole is 6.02 x 10^23 particles.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Molar mass
concepts.description: Molar mass in g/mol is the sum of atomic masses weighted by subscripts.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Balancing equations
concepts.description: Coefficients are added so each element has equal atoms on both sides; subscripts never change.

concepts.subject: chemistry
concepts.name: Stoichiometry
concepts.description: Coefficients give mole ratios used to convert between reactants and products.
